scope: iOS simulator framework linking, Swift host compilation, host tests, and ordinary UI test

host.command: xcodebuild -project ios-app/NoteCorePreview.xcodeproj -scheme NoteCorePreview -sdk iphonesimulator -destination generic/platform=iOS Simulator -derivedDataPath ios-app/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

full_test.command: xcodebuild test -project ios-app/NoteCorePreview.xcodeproj -scheme NoteCorePreview -destination id=7F2A0226-A39E-4A86-BB26-B77DB5E3C1B0 -derivedDataPath ios-app/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

ordinary_ui_tests.journey: two pages, strokes, eraser, undo/redo, background, save, process reopen

environment_note: A stale duplicate project-local .konan bundle was moved out of the project before linking; Kotlin/Native now uses ~/.konan only. This is a machine cache cleanup, not a repository source change.
limitations: UI test does not yet assert pen-slot selection or UserDefaults persistence directly; host model behavior is covered by shared tests and Android process-restart evidence
No physical iPad/iPhone, Pencil, or device persistence test
No production storage or document-format change
